user_intent.original_question: 找出每个电影类型中评分最高的电影，显示类型名、电影标题和评分

business_rules.name: 评分可信度
business_rules.condition: t.num_votes > 10000 AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL

historical_qa_pairs.original_question: 各类型电影平均评分（含热度指数）
historical_qa_pairs.normalized_question: 统计各类型电影的平均评分和热度
historical_qa_pairs.sql: SELECT g.display_name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS movie_count, ROUND(AVG(t.average_rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM titles t JOIN titles_genres tg ON tg.title_id = t.id JOIN genres g ON g.id = tg.genre_id WHERE t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.num_votes > 5000 AND t.start_year >= 2000 AND t.start_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.id, g.display_name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

historical_qa_pairs.normalized_question: 找出每个年代评分最高的电影
historical_qa_pairs.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT primary_title, start_year, average_rating, num_votes, FLOOR(start_year / 10) * 10 AS decade, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FLOOR(start_year / 10) * 10 ORDER BY average_rating DESC) AS rn FROM titles WHERE title_type = 'movie' AND num_votes > 50000 AND start_year IS NOT NULL) SELECT decade AS decade_range, primary_title, start_year, average_rating, num_votes FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY decade_range DESC

knowledge.content: titles 通过 titles_genres 关联 genres，多对多关系。titles_genres 联合主键 (title_id, genre_id)。
genres.id 存的是字符串如 'action', 'comedy'，不是数字ID。genres.display_name 是类型显示名。
排名类查询应加 num_votes > 10000 过滤，低投票数影片评分不可靠。
title_type = 'movie' 才是电影，titles 表包含电视剧、短片、游戏等9种类型。
